=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:217-223 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `grep -qE` treats file read errors the same as “no match,” so the code can fall into the append branch and add a duplicate `model_reasoning_effort` key.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers identified the same read-error-to-append path; severity stays low because the file is local and the script is fail-open.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:226-228 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `sed -i '/^[[:space:]]*model_reasoning_effort[[:space:]]*=/a model_reasoning_summary = "auto"'` appends after every matching effort line, which can create duplicate `model_reasoning_summary` keys if the config has multiple effort entries.
  WHY: Three reviewers reported the same multi-match append behavior; it is low severity because the standard config appears to have only one matching line.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:233-244 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The verification greps require exact matches and do not tolerate whitespace variants, so they can emit warnings even when the rewrite succeeded.
  WHY: Two reviewers flagged the same strict-pattern mismatch; severity is low because the rewrite writes canonical lines, so this is mainly a diagnostic issue.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:217-231 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The generic `::warning::Codex config rewrite failed` message can overstate the failure when the effort write succeeds but the summary write fails.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding; the warning is misleading but the resolver still gets the correct reasoning setting, so impact is low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:218-221 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `grep -qE` key-existence check does not distinguish file read errors from no match, so a read error can route to the append branch and add a duplicate `model_reasoning_effort` line.
  WHY: This is a theoretical edge case on a file that is already guarded by `[ -f ]`, so the trigger is extremely unlikely.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:236, 240 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The post-rewrite verification `! grep -qE` checks collapse grep exit code 2 into “pattern absent,” which can produce a spurious warning on a read error.
  WHY: This is diagnostic-only and would require a transient I/O error on a file that was just read and written.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:226-227 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: `sed -i '/^[[:space:]]*model_reasoning_effort[[:space:]]*=/a model_reasoning_summary = "auto"'` appends after every matching line, which could duplicate the summary key in a multi-section config.
  WHY: The standard runner config appears to have a single matching line; the reviewer considered the multi-section scenario theoretical.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- (No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:233-244 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The verification patterns use exact matching without whitespace tolerance, so they can emit false-positive warnings if the config lines have leading or trailing whitespace.
  WHY: The rewrite patterns tolerate `[[:space:]]*`, but the verification greps do not; impact is low because this only affects warnings.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:228 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `sed -i '/^[[:space:]]*model_reasoning_effort[[:space:]]*=/a model_reasoning_summary = "auto"'` appends after every matching effort line, which can create duplicate summary keys.
  WHY: This only matters if the config has multiple `model_reasoning_effort` lines; the standard config reportedly has one.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:217-223, 233-237 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `grep` exit code 2 is treated the same as “pattern not found,” so a read error can be misclassified.
  WHY: The file existence check and local CI environment make a transient read error very unlikely, and the script is fail-open.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:217-228, 230-231 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The generic rewrite-failed warning can overstate the issue when the effort write succeeds but the summary write fails.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding; it is misleading for operators but does not prevent the resolver from using the correct reasoning effort.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:226 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `sed -i '/^[[:space:]]*model_reasoning_effort[[:space:]]*=/a model_reasoning_summary = "auto"'` appends after every matching effort line, which can create duplicate summary keys if the config has multiple matches.
  WHY: The reviewer considered this a low-probability corruption case on the standard runner config.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:198 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*model_reasoning_effort[[:space:]]*=...'` treats file read errors as no match, routing to the else branch and appending a new effort key.
  WHY: The reviewer says this could lead to duplicate `model_reasoning_effort` keys and undefined TOML behavior, though the practical trigger is rare.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:210 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The second `grep -qE` check similarly treats read errors as no match, which can append a duplicate `model_reasoning_summary` line.
  WHY: Same root cause as the effort-key issue, with low-probability impact on parsing.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:228 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `sed -i '/^[[:space:]]*model_reasoning_effort[[:space:]]*=/a model_reasoning_summary = "auto"'` appends the summary line after every matching effort line.
  WHY: Duplicate appends can arise if multiple effort lines exist, which the reviewer treated as a low-probability but real corruption case.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:233-235 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The verification greps use exact anchors with no whitespace tolerance despite whitespace-tolerant rewrite patterns.
  WHY: This could create false-positive warnings on non-canonical formatting, but the reviewer rates it low risk because the rewrite emits exact lines.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
